error.description: Error is a short, human-readable explanation.
error.example: validation failed: group "x": rules must not be empty

description.example: Block a residential ASN at request time

name.description: Name is the entry key (e.g. group name, fact name).

payload.description:
Payload is the JSON payload exactly as it would appear inside
the YAML policy (decoded into a generic object).

revision.description:
Revision is the opaque concurrency token; pass it back as
`If-Match` to perform a conditional update.

section.description: Section is the parent collection ("groups" or "facts").

BearerAuth.description: Send 'Bearer <token>'. The token is the contents of --admin-token-file on the server.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization

info.description: CRUD over the overlay sections of the policy (groups, facts, defaults, logging). The YAML loaded at boot is the floor; admin writes overlay it per-key and are replicated to peer replicas via a Kubernetes ConfigMap + Lease.
info.title: request-validator admin API
